    Split basic algebras #

    A finite-dimensional algebra B over a field k is split basic if it has a complete family e : ι → B of orthogonal idempotents with e_x B e_x = k e_x ⊕ e_x J e_x and e_x B e_y ⊆ J for x ≠ y, where J = rad B (manuscript, Section 3; note v2, Section 4).

    SplitBasicData records this as plain data. Quotients by two-sided ideals inside J are again split basic with the images of the idempotents (SplitBasicData.quotient), and their radical is the image of J (SplitBasicData.mem_jacobson_quotient_iff).

    structure LargeIndecomposable.SplitBasicData (k : Type u) [Field k] (B : Type v) [Ring B] [Algebra k B] (ι : Type w) [Fintype ι] :
    Type (max v w)

    A split basic algebra: a complete family e : ι → B of nonzero orthogonal idempotents with e_x B e_x ⊆ k e_x + J and e_x B e_y ⊆ J for x ≠ y, where J = Ring.jacobson B.

    • e : ι → B

      The idempotents e_x.

    • complete : CompleteOrthogonalIdempotents self.e
    • ne_zero (x : ι) : self.e x ≠ 0
    • corner_diag (x : ι) (b : B) : ∃ (c : k), self.e x * b * self.e x - c • self.e x ∈ Ring.jacobson B

      e_x B e_x = k e_x + e_x J e_x.

    • corner_offdiag (x y : ι) : x ≠ y → ∀ (b : B), self.e x * b * self.e y ∈ Ring.jacobson B

      e_x B e_y ⊆ J for x ≠ y.
